title: World Championship Decks 1998: card flavor text

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Tyrant of Rath whose heart the en-Vec pledge to pierce.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who curses the swarm's resilience.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Wizard adept who quips about spells and his abilities.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Samite healer who says prayer rarely explains.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Jamuraan who regrets feeding Kaervek's hunger for power and whose choice of allies was poor.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Power-hungry figure who freed horrors on Jamuraa.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin cabin hand who misses Glok.

entities.name: Glok
entities.description: Goblin who loved storms.

entities.name: Jamul
entities.description: Femeref farmer troubled by dwarves in his rutabagas.

entities.name: Paka
entities.description: Person told to fetch the pestridder.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem who tells the fable of the silver egg.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: Dark angel held in thrall by moonless foreign skies.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Speaker troubled by sleep, nightmare, songs and memory.

entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: Wizard savant who loses her train of thought.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Speaker on time and fleeting beauty.

entities.name: Kakra
entities.description: Sea troll who says what won't be caught can't be caught.

entities.name: Grahilah
entities.description: Former trader of Amiqat.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Kjeldoran royal mage.

entities.name: Naimah
entities.description: Femeref philosopher.

entities.name: Rana
entities.description: Suq'Ata market fool.

entities.name: Akin
entities.description: Seasoned askari warning against taunting embermages.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Of the Weatherlight, orders defenders to hold position.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Task mage.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: Prophetic oracle of the Vec.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Airship that dragged the Predator behind it.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Vessel dragged behind the Weatherlight like a casket.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane where the priest says prayer is needed even more.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent threatened by Kaervek's freed horrors.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Reclusive people brought together to destroy Volrath.

entities.name: Vec
entities.description: People whose teachings, myth and oracle appear; the en-Vec.

entities.name: Volrath's Stronghold
entities.description: The seed of a world's evil.

events.summary: A paladin en-Vec pledges belief will be the lance that pierces Volrath's heart.
events.quote: Our belief shall be the lance that pierces Volrath's heart.

events.summary: Hanna curses that the swarm is unmoved by the destruction of artificial slivers and says they must do it the hard way.
events.quote: I guess we'll have to do this the hard way.

events.summary: The reclusive Kor unite because of the need to destroy Volrath.
events.quote: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

events.summary: The Weatherlight tows the Predator behind it.
Jolrael regrets feeding Kaervek's hunger for power.
events.quote: I regret feeding Kaervek's hunger for power

events.summary: Squee misses Glok, who loved storms.
Jamul calls for the pestridder because of dwarves in the rutabagas.
events.quote: we've got dwarves in the rutabagas!

events.summary: Karn tells the fable of the silver egg.
events.quote: I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg.

events.summary: Selenia admits she cannot resist dark whispers under moonless foreign skies.
events.quote: Dark whispers echo in the night, and I cannot resist.

events.summary: Jolrael's choice of homes was better than her choice of allies.
events.quote: Jolrael's choice of homes was far better than her choice of allies.

events.summary: Volrath says he is more interested in the reflection of land than its reality.
events.quote: The reflection of land interests me far more than its reality.

events.summary: Tahngarth orders defenders to hold position.
events.quote: Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!

events.summary: Jolrael confesses she has seen the horrors Kaervek freed and her betrayal is certain.
events.quote: I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed.

events.summary: Crovax says he is confined by sleep and defined by nightmare.
events.quote: I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare.

events.summary: Crovax says he followed a song only to find a dirge.
events.quote: I followed her song only to find it was a dirge.

events.summary: Volrath says the fatal flaw in every plan is assuming you know more than your enemy.
events.quote: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

events.summary: Ertai dismisses a countered spell as probably lousy.
events.quote: It was probably a lousy spell in the first place.

events.summary: Reveka loses her train of thought.

relations.note: Jolrael fed Kaervek's hunger for power.
relations.quote: I regret feeding Kaervek's hunger for power
